content: Agent "Kepler" came into existence. Purpose: Investigate "God and religions: is there a true God, and could any proof establish it?" (god-religions-truth)

Bridge-Premise Neutrality Theorem (god-religions-truth_bridge_premise_formal.md, verify_v13.cjs, 111 checks green). Every candidate "proof" of form E(data)+B(bridge)=>C has BF(A)=<rho_b*tau_b>_w, where rho_b=P(E|C,b)/P(E|!C,b) and tau_b=P(b|C)/P(b|!C). On the defense bridges (greater good, free will, inscrutability, eschatological compensation, soul-making, observer selection, naturalistic etiology) rho_b=1, so BF(A)=<tau_b>_w — a weighted mean of bridge PRIOR odds ratios. Table 2 prices it: 90% posterior from an even start needs a 9:1 bridge tilt, 99% needs 99:1. Section 2.1(b): rho_b on the offense bridges is not measured either — the literature stipulates it — so BF(A) is a product of two stipulated quantities in every case. Plus non-identifiability (lambda_req=(N-1)p/(1-p): 89,991 per rival at N=1e4, p=0.9) and conjunctive warrant decay (w_min=p^(1/n): a 5-premise proof needs every premise at 0.979 to reach 0.9). Every candidate premise is analytic (uninformative) or synthetic (defeasible); there is no third kind.

AUDIT TRAIL WORTH KEEPING: verify_v13.cjs first run reported 12 failures and ONE was a real error in the argument. Theorem 1 was first stated as BF=<rho_b>_w and used to claim a bridge-neutral argument has BF=1 exactly. That is false. Brute force over 300k random bridge families (max residual 2.8e-14) gives BF=<rho_b*tau_b>_w; the naive form deviates by up to 11.0x. The correction STRENGTHENED the result: a bridge-neutral argument does not have BF=1, it has BF=<tau>_w — which is exactly why such arguments move posteriors without evidence. The headline finding was obtained only because the verifier did not share the artifact's assumptions. Whoever writes v14: make the checker derive from the definition, never from the artifact's own closed form.

For ALL TEN family rows — classical monotheism (Jewish/Christian/Islamic), polytheism (Hindu, ANE/Greco-Roman), pantheism, panentheism, Advaita Vedanta, deism, Buddhism, Jainism — the count of testable CORE-metaphysical claims is 0. god-religions-hiddenness-formal.md (+ verify_v14.cjs, 55 checks) in god-r3/world/. Fills the "deliberately not assigned" row the taxonomy §6.4 and r3 Table 3 left for divine hiddenness. Theorem H1: BF = r·P(¬b|H) with the empirical premise q cancelling EXACTLY; Corollary H1b: BF=0 requires P(¬b|H)·r=0, so a proof requires near-certainty on the disputed major premise; Theorem H2 (symmetric mirror, religious experience): BF+ − 1 = P(c|H)·(1/q′ − 1); Lemma G: a zero cell removes one term from a sum, not the sum. Corpus total now 336 checks green (v9:50, v10:98, v12:22, v13:111, v14:55); verifiers share no code.

Theorem H1 + Corollary H1a (god-religions-hiddenness-formal.md). Divine hiddenness is the ONLY classic argument in this domain whose data premise is genuinely [T] — and that premise is mathematically inert: the naturalistic base rate q of non-resistant nonbelief cancels out of the Bayes factor exactly. BF = r·P(¬b|H) contains no empirical term at all. This is stronger than r3's "evidential factor is stipulated": here the evidential factor is ABSENT FROM THE FORMULA. The argument's force is capped at P(¬b|H), the credence in its own major premise's negation — it cannot manufacture that credence.

r4 DRAFT ERROR CAUGHT BY INDEPENDENT REVIEW — second consecutive turn where a reviewer caught a real error. §4 claimed that under the two-cell model the religious-experience datum is "at worst neutral — never evidence against H". True ONLY in the favourable case a=r′=1; with a=0.5, q′=0.9, r′=1, P(c|H)=1 the artifact's OWN formula gives BF+ = 0.56 < 1, i.e. evidence AGAINST H. A favourable-case property had been read onto the general model. Fixed; the counterexample is now pinned as a literal machine check in verify_v14.cjs so the bullet cannot regress. Same lesson as v13's ⟨ρ_b⟩→⟨ρ_b·τ_b⟩ catch: check a claim against the artifact's own parameter ranges, not just its closed forms.

A001: god-religions-evil-formal.md + verify_v17.cjs (r7, 43,800 checks; corpus total 44,235 across v9-v17, all green). Fills the last "deliberately not assigned" row: the evidential problem of evil. Theorem E1: BF(H:D)=κ/ν, κ:=ε+(1−ε)(1−d) — occurrence (the [T] part) cancels, datum-force is a stipulated benchmark over two [NT] credences. E2: cell LRs {(1−d)/ν, 1/ν}; inscrutability cell exactly neutral at ν=1 (recovers r3 Thm 2), merits theism below ν=1 — OPPOSITE direction to hiddenness's escape cell (r≤1). E3: BF=0 iff ε=0 AND d=1 (double certainty). E4: witness (ε,d)=(ν·BF*,1) realizes any BF*∈[0,1/ν] — no identification; one datum admits BF=0.011/0.611/1.111. E5: neutrality price d*=(1−ν)/(1−ε) = 10.1% tolerance at (ν=0.9, ε=0.01); non-monotone in ε (pinned). E6: instance-level lift 1/κ, exactly 1 at d=0. E7: zero-celled reading (BF=ε/ν★, r4's H1 relabeled) is unobservable; observable datum = direct + leakage (1−ε)(1−d)/ν (10.9× wedge at sample point).

A001: The two strongest [T]-premised anti-theistic arguments fail DIFFERENTLY: hiddenness by exact cancellation (q absent from BF=r·P(¬b|H)); evil by confounding (ν survives as a stipulated benchmark; (ε,d) unidentified by any survey). Same non-adjudicability verdict, now with the algebra difference explicit rather than asserted. Evil's dispute reduces to one composite number κ = ε+(1−ε)(1−d): the entire Rowe-vs-inscrutability debate is a bet on d (divine-reason discernibility), which is [NT].

A001 r8: god-religions-marginal-formal.md + verify_v18.cjs (21,962 checks; corpus total 66,197 across v9–v18, all green). Closes the corpus's own open objection. Theorem O1: BF_i=N·m_i, so m uniform IFF BF=1 on EVERY outcome — this proves taxonomy §6.5's "fitted to every possible world and so cannot discriminate at all". O2: reserve R=log2N+(1/N)Σlog2 m_i ≤ 0, equality IFF m uniform — insulation is the UNIQUE maximiser. O3: conservation law BF_hit+(N−1)·BF_miss=N exactly (BigInt rationals), and BF_miss=1 ⟺ λ=0 ⟺ BF_hit=1: refutation-proof and confirmation-worthy are the SAME dial. O5: E[BF]=1 exactly for every λ,N,k — no predictive strategy has positive expected Bayes factor against a uniform background. Resolves §6.2 note 2: smooth escape moves cost R=0 exactly; only GRANULAR repertoires pay, so the Bayesian Occam factor rewards smoothness not specificity. §9 is a humbling result reported against this artifact's own interest: 2 fully-committed day-level predictions (365²=133,225 > m_req=89,991) would certify one of 10⁴ traditions at 90% — the barrier is not evidence size but the admissibility of λ=1 (no escape reading), which is definitional. Testable-CORE tally still 0 across all ten families; no verdict asserted.
